Jwt._comment: Key is intentionally NOT here. Local: dotnet user-secrets set "Jwt:Key" "<32+ chars>" --project OrderRefactor. Production: Key Vault reference in the Jwt__Key environment variable.

AzureAd._comment: Public identifiers, not secrets. An API that only validates tokens needs no client secret: it verifies signatures against Microsoft's published JWKS. Audience is the bare client id because the registration sets requestedAccessTokenVersion=2, which makes aud the app id rather than api://<app-id>.
